headline: Tender deadline day: every club has until 5 p.m. ET to cut or keep its arbitration players, with the lockout 11 days out.

news.title: Rockies acquire Luis Castillo, Davis Martin from White Sox
news.note: Colorado gets two right-handed starters; the White Sox get LHP Sean Sullivan and catching prospect Douglas Veliz. Kansas City also signed Randy Dobnak for one year, $1.35M.

news.title: Padres meet Skubal, plan to be 'ultra-aggressive'
news.note: San Diego became the fourth team to sit down with Skubal after the Mets, Dodgers and Blue Jays. Heyman still calls the Mets the expected landing spot.
Morosi says more than a half-dozen teams are on Brandon Lowe, including the Pirates and Rays. Mooney reports the Cubs have scouted Teruaki Sato and evaluated Jarren Duran.
news.title: Hot Stove: Lowe draws strong interest; Cubs scout Sato, eye Duran

news.note: MLB's plan is a $258.2M cap and $180.2M floor from 2028. The Dodgers would be $174M over; a Dec. 2 lockout would freeze all signings and trades.
news.title: Manfred: no labor deal without a cap and floor

news.note: Two years, $55M guaranteed, with a $30M player option for 2028. Gray, 37, had a 2.72 ERA and finished fifth in AL Cy Young voting.
news.title: Twins sign Sonny Gray

news.note: Seattle gets Garcia, James McArthur and L.P. Langevin; Kansas City gets Miller, Logan Evans and Jose A. Ferrer. Dipoto says no more starters will be traded.
news.title: Royals, Mariners swap Maikel Garcia for Bryce Miller in six-player deal
